metadata.question: Between June 15-21, 2017, did temperatures in Las Vegas, Nevada exceed 130 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: The user is asking: "Between June 15-21, 2017, did temperatures in Las Vegas, Nevada exceed 130 degrees fahrenheit?" Interpretation: We need to check land surface temperature (LST) in Las Vegas during June 15-21, 2017 to see if it exceeded 130°F. Plan: 1. Data Collection: Use MODIS Land Surface Temperature product (MOD11A1.061 or MYD11A1.061) which provides daily LST in Kelvin. 2. Geometry: Las Vegas, Nevada - use a point with buffer for region of interest. 3. Time Range: June 15-21, 2017. 4. Temperature Conversion: Convert from Kelvin to Fahrenheit: °F = (9/5)*(K - 273.15) + 32 5. Cloud/Quality Masking: Use QC_Day band to mask poor quality pixels. 6. Check: For each image in the collection, compute maximum temperature over the ROI. If any max exceeds 130°F, answer A (Yes), otherwise B (No). 7. Handle edge cases: If no images, try fallback (Aqua MODIS). If still no images, output C1. If images but no valid pixels, output C2. If calculation fails, output C3. Structure: 1. Define geometry and time. 2. Load MODIS Terra collection (MOD11A1.061). 3. Check size, if 0, try Aqua (MYD11A1.061). 4. If both empty, output C1. 5. Process collection: Map over images to get max temperature after masking. 6. Reduce collection to overall maximum. 7. Check pixel count to ensure valid data. 8. Validate result (not NaN, reasonable range). 9. Output answer. Note: We'll use a buffer of 10km around Las Vegas center point for ROI. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var lasVegas = ee.Geometry.Point(-115.1398, 36.1699).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer var startDate = '2017-06-15'; var endDate = '2017-06-22'; // exclusive // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra LST (MOD11A1.061) var modisTerra = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(lasVegas); var terraSize = modisTerra.size().getInfo(); print('MODIS Terra Images:', terraSize); var lstCollection; if (terraSize === 0) { // Try Aqua MODIS as fallback var modisAqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(lasVegas); var aquaSize = modisAqua.size().getInfo(); print('MODIS Aqua Images:', aquaSize); if (aquaSize === 0) { print('No MODIS Terra or Aqua images found.'); print('C1'); return; } lstCollection = modisAqua; } else { lstCollection = modisTerra; } // 3. Processing: Convert LST to Fahrenheit and mask poor quality var convertToF = function(image) { var lstK = image.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02); // Scale factor for MODIS LST var lstC = lstK.subtract(273.15); // Kelvin to Celsius var lstF = lstC.multiply(9/5).add(32); // Celsius to Fahrenheit // Quality mask: bits 0-1 of QC_Day < 2 (good or other quality) var qc = image.select('QC_Day'); var mask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lt(2); // 3 = binary 11 return lstF.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start']); }; var processedCol = lstCollection.map(convertToF); // 4. Calculate maximum temperature over the week // Create a mosaic of the week by taking max pixel value var maxLstImage = processedCol.max(); // Check valid pixel count var pixelCount = maxLstImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lasVegas, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); print('Valid pixels after masking:', pixelCount); if (pixelCount === 0) { print('No valid pixels after quality masking.'); print('C2'); return; } // Get maximum temperature in ROI var maxTemp = maxLstImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: lasVegas, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); print('Maximum temperature (°F):', maxTemp); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (maxTemp === null || maxTemp === undefined || isNaN(maxTemp)) { print('Calculation failed - result is NaN or null.'); print('C3'); } else if (maxTemp < -100 || maxTemp > 200) { // Unreasonable temperature range print('Temperature outside reasonable range.'); print('C3'); } else if (maxTemp > 130) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
